apps.name: TouchDesigner
apps.shortDescription: Build real-time audiovisual systems for interactive media, projection, and live performance.
apps.overview: A node-based visual programming platform for real-time audiovisual works, interactive media, projection, and live performance.
apps.howItWorks: It receives inputs such as live audio, MIDI, OSC, webcam, or sensors and maps them to real-time visuals and media outputs.
pros: Supports MIDI, audio, OSC, Python, video, and sensors
Free Non-Commercial version for learning and prototypes
cons: Requires a capable GPU for complex live visuals
Needs technical rehearsal and a backup video for performances
apps.suggestedUseCase: Create an audio-reactive visual scene for one original CMD Lab composition, then export a backup video for the performance.
apps.owner: To be assigned by the CMD Lab committee

apps.name: Ableton Live
apps.shortDescription: Compose, record, arrange, and perform music with a flexible clip-based workflow.
apps.overview: A digital audio workstation designed for music production and live performance.
apps.howItWorks: Arrangement View supports timeline-based production, while Session View launches musical clips and scenes in real time. MIDI devices and effects can be mapped for performance control.
memberUses: Design sounds with instruments and effects
pros: Strong connection between studio production and live performance
cons: Full projects can demand substantial CPU and storage
Live sets require careful file and plugin management
apps.suggestedUseCase: Prepare a Session View set with stems, click tracks, and mapped controls for a CMD Lab performance.
apps.owner: To be assigned by the CMD Lab committee

apps.name: Sonic Pi
apps.shortDescription: Learn coding and musical thinking through accessible live-coded composition.
apps.overview: A free live-coding environment created for making and teaching music through code.
apps.howItWorks: Users write short Ruby-like commands to play notes, samples, loops, and effects, then update the code while the music continues.
pros: Useful for connecting computational and musical thinking
cons: Text-based interaction may challenge some learners
Less suitable for detailed multitrack production
Complex performances still require coding practice
apps.suggestedUseCase: Run a short workshop in which members transform a simple loop by changing rhythm, pitch, and timbre in code.
apps.owner: To be assigned by the CMD Lab committee

apps.name: Max/MSP
apps.shortDescription: Patch together custom systems for sound, media, sensors, and interactive performance.
apps.overview: A visual programming environment for building custom audio, video, and interactive media tools.
apps.howItWorks: Users connect functional objects in a patch. Messages, audio signals, MIDI, and sensor data flow between the objects to create an interactive system.
pros: Supports custom interfaces and external hardware
cons: Patches can become difficult to maintain
Requires time to learn signal flow and debugging
apps.suggestedUseCase: Prototype a small sensor-controlled instrument with one clearly defined musical interaction before expanding the patch.
apps.owner: To be assigned by the CMD Lab committee

apps.name: Chrome Music Lab
apps.shortDescription: Explore sound and musical concepts through simple browser-based experiments.
apps.overview: A collection of free web experiments that make musical concepts visible and interactive.
apps.howItWorks: Each experiment focuses on an idea such as rhythm, melody, harmonics, or sound waves and provides direct visual feedback in a web browser.
cons: Outputs are less flexible than a full DAW
apps.suggestedUseCase: Use Song Maker for a short composition task, followed by a discussion of pattern, form, and instrumentation choices.
apps.owner: To be assigned by the CMD Lab committee

apps.name: Suno
apps.shortDescription: Generate music from text prompts for rapid ideation and critical AI exploration.
apps.overview: A generative AI music platform that creates songs and instrumental material from text-based instructions.
apps.howItWorks: Users describe musical characteristics or lyrics in a prompt. The service generates audio options that can be reviewed, revised, or used as references for further work.
memberUses: Explore authorship and ethics in music education
pros: Useful for discussing prompt design and AI literacy
cons: Terms, access limits, and output rights require checking
Outputs may be generic or inconsistent
Should not replace members’ compositional decision-making
apps.suggestedUseCase: Compare two prompt-generated drafts, identify their musical limitations, and recompose one idea through human performance and arrangement.
apps.owner: To be assigned by the CMD Lab committee
